suppress.notes: reactor-netty and Spring Boot's Netty integration are taken for Netty itself, at their own version numbers (1.3.x, 4.0.x), which brings in every Netty CVE back to 2019. Netty is scanned separately as netty-*.jar with its real version.
The CVEs of minio:minio are for the MinIO object storage server, not for the MinIO Java client SDK that SIRIUS uses for custom databases at s3:// locations.
The SPLASH spectral hash library (edu.ucdavis.fiehnlab.splash:core) is taken for Spring Framework 1.8.
Libraries named *utils* (SIRIUS's own chemdb_utils_oss, graph_utils_oss, jwt_utils, utils, and native-utils) are taken for the unrelated project "fredsmith utils" (CVE-2021-4277).
zip4jvm (ru.oleg-cherednik.zip4jvm) is a different library than zip4j; the zip4j CVEs do not apply to it. zip4j itself is scanned separately.
JNA (Java Native Access) is taken for Sun/Oracle Java SE at version 5.x, which matches 2009 CVEs for Java SE 5 and 6 (JMX, Web Start, AWT).
xz-java (org.tukaani:xz) is taken for XZ Utils. Its CVEs are for the xzgrep/gzip shell scripts and the XZ Utils C library; xz-java is a separate pure Java implementation.
CVE-2018-1258 affects Spring Framework 5.0.5 used together with Spring Security, not Spring Security 7.
CVE-2026-53914 concerns build-cache metadata in the Kotlin build tooling, not the Kotlin standard library that is shipped (low-confidence match).
CVE-2023-31890 is in glazedlists' XML bean serialization (ca.odell.glazedlists.impl.io.BeanXMLByteCoder), which SIRIUS never uses; it uses glazedlists for GUI tables only. No fixed version exists.

CVE-2026-45205 is in commons-configuration2's YAML support (YAMLConfiguration), which SIRIUS does not use; it reads its own .properties files only. 2.15.0 fixes it, but 2.12 and later only load configuration URLs with an allowed scheme, which breaks loading SIRIUS's property files from the Spring Boot jar (jar:nested: URLs).

CVE-2017-1000190 is the XXE in the original Simple XML 2.7.1. simple-xml-safe is the Carrot Search fork whose parsers disable external entities. It comes with the MinIO client; SIRIUS does not use it directly.

zlib1.dll in the CBC solver natives 2.10.12.1 is zlib 1.3.1 ("deflate 1.3.1" / "inflate 1.3.1" in the DLL). It has no version resource, so the scanner guesses a 1.2.x version - a different one from run to run - and reports the CVEs of that version. The identifier is wrong, so it is suppressed; this is pinned to the CBC version that was checked. Known CVEs that cover 1.3.1 itself, checked by hand on 2026-10-23: CVE-2026-22184 (contrib/untgz demo utility) and CVE-2023-45853 (MiniZip), neither of which is part of zlib1.dll, and CVE-2026-27171 (CPU consumption in crc32_combine64, fixed in 1.3.2), which is part of it but not reachable: SIRIUS passes models to CBC in memory and never has it read compressed files. SBOM-based scans see the real version (zlib in sbom.cdx.json) and report CVE-2026-27171 until the CBC natives are rebuilt with zlib 1.3.2.
